name: WDC Products Hardware Listings Downsampled Source-Schema Variant 4 (abbreviated short-form)
description: Hardware product listings from the WDC Products benchmark, with structured attributes taken from the original LLM extraction before downstream normalization. No downstream brand mapping, unit conversion, numeric parsing, rounding or text cleanup is applied. Some conversions already performed by the extraction model remain. Column names retain the source schema, but unit suffixes are not guarantees of the raw units; use the original title and description for unit context. The redundant combined title-description column has been removed and rows are independently shuffled

variableMeasured.name: amt
variableMeasured.description: Original listed price text before numeric parsing or rounding.

variableMeasured.name: cur
variableMeasured.description: ISO currency code of the listed price

variableMeasured.name: link
variableMeasured.description: Source URL of the product listing

variableMeasured.name: cat
variableMeasured.description: Product category (GPU, SSD, HDD or USB_STICK)

variableMeasured.name: vram
variableMeasured.description: Video memory size in gigabytes Raw extracted value; the original unit may differ from the column-name suffix. Consult title and description.
